jobs.title: Customer Logistics Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Customer Logistics Manager (m/f/d) to join the Global Supply Chain Operations Organization in Kaiseraugst. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the timely and reliable supply of semi-finished and finished products to third-party customer markets worldwide, maintaining high service levels, right-first-time order fulfillment and full compliance with quality and documentation requirements.

Working closely with global and local stakeholders, as well as cross-functional planning and logistics teams, you will coordinate upstream replenishment activities, maintain accurate master data and ensure appropriate supply chain setups. In addition, you will drive continuous improvements to the cost-to-serve model, leverage data analytics and technology to optimize supply chain performance, and identify opportunities to increase efficiency and productivity while ensuring customer needs and global supply objectives are met.

Start date: asap/latest 18.01.2027

Planed Durration: 12 Months (extension possible)

Workload: 100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Kaiseraugst

Remote: Yes, max 40%

Your tasks:
• You ensure global market supply to third party customers on time in full at the right quality and cost
• You partner with different interfaces for upstream replenishment coordination from central packaging
• You continuously improve the cost-to-serve-model (incl. KPI metrics).
• You leverage data for decision making by using e.g. analytics, simulation tools and customer insights
• You drive efficiency through identifying value-adding and productivity-enhancing opportunities through technology and data
• You collaborate with different functions in the markets to understand the changes which may impact supply to the country and align with planning functions to adjust the Replenishment Plan
• You ensure appropriate supply chain set-up (incl. e.g. master data)

Your Profile:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent specialized training).
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Supply Chain Management and Operations within the pharmaceutical industry.
• SAP, Microsoft Office, and familiar with AI-driven supply chain tools/analytics.
• Professional fluency in English (written and spoken); German is a plus

Job profile
• Life Sciences - Supply Chain / Operations
• Aargau
• Contracting
• Full Time
• asap/latest by 18.01.27 - 12 Months
• Supply Chain Management, Logistics, SAP, GMP

In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili di garantire la fornitura tempestiva e affidabile di prodotti semilavorati e finiti ai mercati dei clienti di terze parti in tutto il mondo, mantenendo alti livelli di servizio, adempimento dell'ordine di prima volta e pieno rispetto dei requisiti di qualità e documentazione.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder globali e locali, così come i team di pianificazione e logistica interfunzionali, coordinare le attività di rifornimento a monte, mantenere i dati master accurati e garantire le opportune configurazioni della supply chain. Inoltre, aumenterai i continui miglioramenti al modello di costo-to-serve, levierai l'analisi dei dati e la tecnologia per ottimizzare le prestazioni della supply chain e identificare le opportunità per aumentare l'efficienza e la produttività, garantendo al contempo le esigenze dei clienti e gli obiettivi globali di fornitura sono soddisfatti.

• Migliora continuamente il modello economico-serve (incl. metriche KPI).
• Si sfruttano i dati per il processo decisionale utilizzando, ad esempio, strumenti di analisi, strumenti di simulazione e approfondimenti dei clienti
• Si guida l'efficienza attraverso l'individuazione delle opportunità di riduzione del valore e di miglioramento della produttività attraverso tecnologia e dati

• SAP, Microsoft Office, e familiarità con gli strumenti/analytics della supply chain di AI-driven.
• Fluency professionale in inglese (scritto e parlato); tedesco è un plus

In dieser Rolle sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die zeitnahe und zuverlässige Lieferung von Halbfertig- und Fertigprodukten an Drittkundenmärkte weltweit sicherzustellen, ein hohes Serviceniveau, die richtige Erstbestellabwicklung und die vollständige Einhaltung der Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsanforderungen aufrechtzuerhalten.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und lokalen Stakeholdern sowie funktionsübergreifenden Planungs- und Logistikteams koordinieren Sie vorgelagerte Wiederauffüllungsaktivitäten, pflegen genaue Stammdaten und sorgen für angemessene Supply-Chain-Einstellungen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen des Cost-to-Service-Modells vorantreiben, Datenanalysen und -technologien nutzen, um die Leistung der Lieferkette zu optimieren und Möglichkeiten zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Produktivität zu identifizieren und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass die Kundenbedürfnisse und globalen Lieferziele erreicht werden.

Startdatum: asap/latest 18.01.2027

Geplante Dauer: 12 Monate (Verlängerung möglich)

Workload: 100%

Art des Vertrags: Vertrag

Standort: Kaiseraugst

Fernbedienung: Ja, max. 40%

Ihre Aufgaben:
• Sie sichern die weltweite Versorgung von Drittkunden rechtzeitig und zu den richtigen Preisen
• Sie arbeiten mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen für die vorgelagerte Nachschubkoordination von der zentralen Verpackung zusammen
• Sie verbessern kontinuierlich das Cost-to-Serve-Modell (inkl. KPI-Metriken).
• Sie nutzen Daten für die Entscheidungsfindung, indem Sie z. B. Analysen, Simulationstools und Kundeninformationen verwenden
• Sie steigern die Effizienz durch die Identifizierung wertschöpfender und produktivitätssteigernder Möglichkeiten durch Technologie und Daten
• Sie arbeiten mit verschiedenen Funktionen in den Märkten zusammen, um die Veränderungen zu verstehen, die sich auf die Versorgung des Landes auswirken können, und stimmen sich mit den Planungsfunktionen ab, um den Wiederauffüllungsplan anzupassen
• Sie sorgen für einen angemessenen Aufbau der Supply Chain (u.a. Stammdaten)

Ihr Profil:
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Supply Chain Management, Logistik, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige spezialisierte Ausbildung).
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Supply Chain Management und Operations in der pharmazeutischen Industrie.
• SAP, Microsoft Office und vertraut mit KI-gesteuerten Supply Chain Tools / Analysen.
• Professionelle Englischkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen); Deutsch ist ein Plus

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Pour notre client, nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de logistique client expérimenté (h/f/d) pour rejoindre la Global Supply Chain Operations Organization à Kaiseraugst. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable d'assurer la fourniture rapide et fiable de produits semi-finis et finis aux marchés clients tiers dans le monde entier, en maintenant des niveaux de service élevés, le respect de la première commande et le plein respect des exigences de qualité et de documentation.

En étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes mondiales et locales, ainsi qu'avec des équipes de planification et de logistique interfonctionnelles, vous coordonnerez les activités de reconstitution en amont, conserverez des données de base précises et assurerez les configurations appropriées de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. De plus, vous dirigerez des améliorations continues au modèle de coût à service, tirerez parti de l'analyse des données et de la technologie pour optimiser les performances de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, et identifierez les possibilités d'accroître l'efficacité et la productivité tout en assurant la satisfaction des besoins des clients et des objectifs d'approvisionnement mondiaux.

Date de début: dès/dernier 18.01.2027

Durée prévue: 12 mois (extension possible)

Charge de travail: 100%

Type de contrat: Contrat

Lieu: Kaiseraugst

Télécommande: Oui, max 40%

Vos tâches:
• Vous assurez l'approvisionnement du marché mondial à des clients tiers à temps complet à la bonne qualité et coût
• Vous êtes partenaire de différentes interfaces pour la coordination de la reconstitution en amont à partir de l'emballage central
• Vous améliorez continuellement le modèle de coût à service (y compris les métriques KPI).
• Vous tirez parti des données pour la prise de décision en utilisant, par exemple, des outils d'analyse, des outils de simulation et des informations client
• Vous conduisez l'efficacité en identifiant des possibilités d'augmentation de valeur et de productivité grâce à la technologie et aux données
• Vous collaborez avec différentes fonctions sur les marchés pour comprendre les changements qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur l'approvisionnement du pays et vous aligner sur les fonctions de planification pour ajuster le plan de reconstitution
• Vous assurez une configuration appropriée de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (y compris les données de base)

Votre profil:
• Études: Baccalauréat en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, logistique, affaires ou un domaine connexe (ou formation spécialisée équivalente).
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et opérations dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• SAP, Microsoft Office, et familier avec les outils/analyses de chaîne d'approvisionnement pilotés par l'IA.
• Connaissance professionnelle de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); l'allemand est un plus

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst:in - Derivate (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden aus der Finanzbranche in der Umgebung Bern , suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n und aufgeschlossene:n Senior Business Analyst:in - Derivate .

In diesem Projekt übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Analyse, Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung eines zentralisierten Orderflows im Bereich Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD). Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Handel, Operations und IT und unterstützt die Optimierung sowie Standardisierung von Handels- und Abwicklungsprozessen.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Analyse der bestehenden ETD-Orderflows und Abwicklungsprozesse sowie Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
• Erhebung, Strukturierung und Dokumentation fachlicher Anforderungen in Form von Fachkonzepten, User Stories und Spezifikationen
• Entwicklung von Lösungskonzepten für die Zentralisierung des Orderflows innerhalb eines Order Management Systems (OMS)
• Definition und Spezifikation der Schnittstellen zwischen Handelssystemen, OMS und nachgelagerten Abwicklungsplattformen
• Enge Abstimmung mit Stakeholdern aus Handel, Operations, IT, Compliance und weiteren Fachbereichen
• Planung, Konzeption und Begleitung von Fachtests, Integrationstests und User Acceptance Tests (UAT) bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung der Lösung

Dein Profil:
• Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung ist zwingend
• 5–10 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Business Analyst im Kapitalmarkt- oder Handelsumfeld
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) , insbesondere entlang des gesamten Order-Lifecycles inklusive Allokation, Give-up, Clearing und Settlement
• Erfahrung mit Order Management Systemen (OMS) sowie Abwicklungs- und Settlement-Prozessen
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Business-Analyse-Methoden, Requirements Engineering und Prozessmodellierung (z. B. User Stories, BPMN)
• Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie Tools wie Jira , Confluence und SQL
• Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Business- und IT-Stakeholdern
• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Definizione e specificazione di interfacce tra sistemi di trading, piattaforme OMS e di regolamento a valle
• Coordinamento stretto con le parti interessate dal commercio, dalle operazioni, dall'IT, dalla conformità e da altre aree specializzate
• Pianificazione, concezione e supporto di test specialistici, test di integrazione e test di accettazione dell'utente (UAT) fino alla riuscita introduzione della soluzione

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our clients from the financial industry in the area of Bern, we are looking for:n experienced:n and open-minded:n Senior Business Analyst:in derivatives.

In this project, you take on a central role in the analysis, conception and further development of a centralized order flow in the area of Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD). You work at the interface between trading, operations and IT and support the optimization and standardization of trading and settlement processes.

Your tasks:
• Analysis of existing ETD orderflows and processing processes as well as identification of optimization potential
• Collection, structuring and documentation of technical requirements in the form of technical concepts, user stories and specifications
• Development of solution concepts for the centralization of the order flow within an order management system (OMS)
• Definition and specification of interfaces between trading systems, OMS and downstream settlement platforms
• Close coordination with stakeholders from trade, operations, IT, compliance and other specialist areas
• Planning, conception and support of specialist tests, integration tests and user acceptance tests (UAT) until the successful introduction of the solution

Your profile:
• University degree in business administration, business informatics or a comparable discipline is mandatory
• 5–10 years of professional experience as a business analyst in the capital market or trading environment
• In-depth knowledge of Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD), especially along the entire order lifecycle including allocation, give-up, clearing and settlement
• Experience with order management systems (OMS) as well as settlement and settlement processes
• Very good knowledge of business analysis methods, requirements engineering and process modeling (e.g. user stories, BPMN)
• Experience with agile working methods as well as tools such as Jira, Confluence and SQL
• Strong analytical, conceptual and structured working method
• Very good communication skills and experience working with business and IT stakeholders
• Fluent knowledge of German as well as very good knowledge of English in word and writing

jobs.title: Lab Automation Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Lab Automation Specialist to support qualification, validation, and lifecycle management activities for laboratory systems and equipment within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. In this role, you will collaborate closely with laboratory and quality teams to ensure compliance, operational excellence, and the reliable performance of critical laboratory systems.

Key Facts
• Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland
• Work Model: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)
• Workload: 100%
• Contract Duration: Until December 2027
• Start Date: As soon as possible
• Industry: Pharmaceutical
• Language: English required, German is an advantage

Tasks
• Plan and coordinate qualification activities for laboratory equipment in compliance with GMP and regulatory requirements
• Configure and maintain Empower projects, instrument methods, processing methods, and system settings
• Prepare and execute change controls related to equipment lifecycle management
• Create qualification lifecycle documentation, including:
• Impact Assessments
• Risk Assessments
• User Requirement Specifications (URS)
• IQ/OQ/PQ protocols
• Decommissioning documents
• Develop and maintain SOPs and work instructions related to laboratory equipment lifecycle management
• Identify and document applicable pharmacopeial requirements for analytical laboratory equipment
• Provide operational support to QC and R&D laboratories
• Troubleshoot laboratory systems and equipment issues
• Coordinate with external vendors regarding technical support, maintenance, calibration, investigations, and qualification activities
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within laboratory operations and compliance processes

Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Natural Sciences, Engineering, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field
• Alternatively, equivalent technical training combined with relevant professional experience

Experience & Skills
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment
• Proven experience in qualification and validation of laboratory equipment and/or manufacturing systems
• Hands-on experience with Empower and/or eLIMS in a regulated laboratory environment
• Strong knowledge of equipment lifecycle management and qualification documentation
• Experience preparing and managing IQ/OQ/PQ documentation, URS, risk assessments, and change controls
• Familiarity with pharmacopeial requirements and laboratory compliance standards
• Project management experience within regulated environments
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent English language skills

Preferred
• Experience with SCADA and/or MES systems
• Knowledge of QMS, ERP systems, document management systems, and change management tools
• German language skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Senior SAP Basis Engineer to join the IT organization in a global enterprise environment. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, security, and continuous improvement of the SAP landscape, ensuring the stability, performance, availability, and compliance of mission-critical SAP systems across SAP Private Cloud and on-premises environments.

Working closely with SAP, infrastructure, application, security teams, and external service providers, you will provide technical leadership for SAP infrastructure initiatives, upgrades, migrations, and cloud transformations. In addition, you will drive operational excellence through proactive monitoring, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring compliance with security standards, regulatory requirements, and business objectives.

Start date: 30 Nov 2026

Planed Durration: 29 Nov 2027

Workload: 100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Visp

Remote: Yes, one day/week

Your tasks:
• Ensure high availability, stability, and performance of SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Solution Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Router, Web Dispatcher, and related technologies.
• Lead technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex SAP Basis incidents and performance issues.
• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, and performance optimization activities.
• Ensure compliance with defined service levels (SLAs), operational KPIs, and availability targets.
• Coordinate disaster recovery testing, business continuity activities, and system resilience improvements.
SAP Architecture & Engineering
• Design and maintain SAP system architectures aligned with enterprise standards and business requirements.
• Lead SAP installation, upgrades, migrations, refreshes, Unicode conversions, and technical conversions.
• Provide technical expertise for S/4HANA transformations, cloud migrations, and strategic SAP initiatives.
• Define SAP infrastructure standards, lifecycle management strategies, and operational best practices.
• Evaluate new SAP technologies and coordinate proof-of-concept activities.
Security & Compliance
• Ensure SAP platforms comply with company security policies and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate implementation of SAP Security Notes, kernel patches, and operating system updates.
• Support audits and validation activities related to GxP, SOX, and cybersecurity controls.
• Drive vulnerability remediation and security hardening activities across the SAP landscape.
• Ensure proper technical documentation and compliance evidence is maintained.
Cloud & SAP Private Cloud Operations
• Act as technical counterpart for SAP and managed service providers in SAP Private Cloud environments.
• Coordinate SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, and monitoring integrations.
• Support SAP BTP integrations and cloud-based SAP services.
• Manage relationships with SAP support teams and cloud service providers to ensure operational excellence.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities for automation of SAP operational activities.
• Develop and improve automated monitoring, reporting, deployment, and maintenance processes.
• Implement best practices for operational efficiency and service quality.
• Drive continuous service improvement initiatives based on operational metrics and business needs.
Vendor & Service Management
• Provide technical governance and oversight of outsourced service providers.
• Review service delivery quality, operational performance, and contractual commitments.
• Support transition, transformation, and optimization initiatives involving external partners.
• Ensure adherence to operational processes, standards, and change management requirements.
Project Leadership
• Serve as SAP Basis technical lead for infrastructure and application projects.
• Coordinate technical activities across multiple teams and suppliers.
• Participate in project planning, risk management, cutover execution, and post-go-live support.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior SAP Basis engineers.

Your Profile:
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Experience
• 8+ years of SAP Basis administration and engineering experience.
• Strong experience supporting large enterprise SAP landscapes.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA and HANA databases.
• Experience with SAP Private Cloud Edition (PCE) environments.
• Proven experience managing outsourced SAP operational services.
• Experience leading SAP technical projects and migrations.

Job profile
• Life Sciences - Engineering TechOps
• Wallis
• Contracting
• Full Time
• 30 Nov 2026 - 29 Nov 2027
• SAP Basis administration, SAP S/4HANA , SAP Private Cloud Edition, SAP Business Technology Platform

Per il nostro cliente, stiamo cercando un esperto Senior SAP Basis Engineer per aderire all'organizzazione IT in un ambiente aziendale globale. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della progettazione, implementazione, funzionamento, sicurezza e miglioramento continuo del paesaggio SAP, garantendo stabilità, performance, disponibilità e conformità dei sistemi SAP mission-critical in ambienti SAP Private Cloud e on-premises.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con SAP, infrastrutture, applicazioni, team di sicurezza e fornitori di servizi esterni, fornirete la leadership tecnica per le iniziative di infrastruttura SAP, aggiornamenti, migrazioni e trasformazioni cloud. Inoltre, guiderai l'eccellenza operativa attraverso iniziative di monitoraggio proattivo, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, automazione e miglioramento continuo, garantendo al contempo la conformità con gli standard di sicurezza, i requisiti normativi e gli obiettivi aziendali.

Data di inizio: 30 Nov 2026

Durata prevista: 29 Nov 2027

Carico di lavoro: 100%

Tipo di contratto: Contratto

Posizione: Visp

Telecomando: Sì, un giorno / settimana

I vostri compiti:
• Assicurare elevata disponibilità, stabilità e prestazioni dei paesaggi SAP tra cui S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Solution Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Router, Web Dispatcher e tecnologie correlate.
• Guidare la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e la risoluzione di complessi incidenti SAP Basis e problemi di prestazioni.
• Guidare attività di monitoraggio proattivo, pianificazione della capacità e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei livelli di servizio definiti (SLA), KPI operativi e obiettivi di disponibilità.
• Coordinate i test di ripristino dei disastri, le attività di continuità aziendale e i miglioramenti della resilienza del sistema.
SAP Architettura & Ingegneria
• Progettare e mantenere architetture di sistema SAP allineate agli standard aziendali e ai requisiti aziendali.
• Piombo installazione SAP, aggiornamenti, migrazioni, rinfreschi, conversioni Unicode e conversioni tecniche.
• Fornire competenze tecniche per trasformazioni S/4HANA, migrazioni cloud e iniziative strategiche SAP.
• Definire gli standard delle infrastrutture SAP, le strategie di gestione del ciclo di vita e le migliori pratiche operative.
• Valutare le nuove tecnologie SAP e coordinare le attività di proof-of-concept.
Sicurezza e conformità
• Assicurarsi che le piattaforme SAP siano conformi alle politiche di sicurezza aziendale e ai requisiti normativi.
• Coordinate l'implementazione di SAP Security Notes, patch del kernel e aggiornamenti del sistema operativo.
• Supporta le attività di audit e validazione relative ai controlli GxP, SOX e cybersecurity.
• Guidare le attività di correzione della vulnerabilità e di indurimento della sicurezza in tutto il paesaggio SAP.
• Assicurare la corretta documentazione tecnica e le prove di conformità sono mantenute.
Cloud & SAP Private Cloud Operations
• Agire come controparte tecnica per SAP e i fornitori di servizi gestiti in ambienti SAP Private Cloud.
• Coordinate le integrazioni SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager e monitoraggio.
• Supporta le integrazioni SAP BTP e i servizi SAP basati su cloud.
• Gestisci le relazioni con i team di supporto SAP e i fornitori di servizi cloud per garantire l'eccellenza operativa.
Automazione e miglioramento continuo
• Identificare le opportunità di automazione delle attività operative SAP.
• Sviluppare e migliorare i processi di monitoraggio, reporting, distribuzione e manutenzione automatizzati.
• Implementare le migliori pratiche per l'efficienza operativa e la qualità del servizio.
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo dei servizi basate sulle metriche operative e sulle esigenze aziendali.
Gestione dei servizi
• Fornire governance tecnica e supervisione di fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Verifica la qualità della consegna dei servizi, le prestazioni operative e gli impegni contrattuali.
• Supporta iniziative di transizione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione che coinvolgono partner esterni.
• Assicurare l'adesione a processi operativi, standard e requisiti di gestione dei cambiamenti.
Leadership del progetto
• Servire come lead tecnico SAP Basis per progetti infrastrutturali e applicativi.
• Coordinare le attività tecniche su più team e fornitori.
• Partecipa alla pianificazione del progetto, alla gestione dei rischi, all'esecuzione dei tagli e al supporto post-go-live.
• Fornire assistenza tecnica e mentoring agli ingegneri SAP Basis junior.

Il tuo profilo:
• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria, o esperienza equivalente.
Esperienza
• 8+ anni di amministrazione e esperienza ingegneristica SAP Basis.
• Esperienza forte che supporta grandi paesaggi SAP aziendali.
• Esperienza con database SAP S/4HANA e HANA.
• Esperienza con ambienti SAP Private Cloud Edition (PCE) .
• Provata esperienza di gestione dei servizi operativi SAP outsourced.
• Esperienza leader SAP progetti tecnici e migrazioni.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la conception, de la mise en œuvre, de l'exploitation, de la sécurité et de l'amélioration continue du paysage SAP, assurant la stabilité, la performance, la disponibilité et la conformité des systèmes SAP essentiels à la mission dans les environnements SAP Private Cloud et sur site.

En étroite collaboration avec SAP, infrastructure, applications, équipes de sécurité et fournisseurs de services externes, vous assurerez le leadership technique des initiatives d'infrastructure SAP, des mises à niveau, des migrations et des transformations cloud. De plus, vous dirigerez l'excellence opérationnelle grâce à des initiatives proactives de surveillance, d'optimisation des performances, d'automatisation et d'amélioration continue, tout en assurant le respect des normes de sécurité, des exigences réglementaires et des objectifs opérationnels.

jobs.title: Network Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Network Engineer to join the Connectivity Platform Success team at Roche. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and delivering network infrastructure initiatives across the Basel and Kaiseraugst campuses, covering corporate networks, manufacturing areas, and data centers. You will manage the end-to-end delivery of network solutions, from requirements gathering and technical design to implementation, commissioning, and operational handover.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external service providers, you will ensure reliable network infrastructure through hands-on expertise in LAN/WLAN, Cisco and Arista technologies, routing and switching, and troubleshooting. Additionally, you will oversee physical network environments and drive continuous improvement across the campus network infrastructure.

Start date: asap/latest by 01.02.27

Planed Durration: 12 Months (big Option for extension)

Workload: 100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Basel and Kaiseraugst

Remote: No

Your tasks:
• You support network infrastructure needs in Basel and Kaiseraugst Campuses, covering the corporate campus network, manufacturing areas, and computer rooms.
• You lead end-to-end network delivery: handle business needs analysis, solution design (aligned with our engineering standards), planning, implementation (procurement management, coordinate equipment installation, configuration, commissioning), documentation, and handoff to Operations.
• You Oversee physical network environments and coordinate external installation contractors and service providers across campus facilities.
• You manage the full lifecycle of the installed network infrastructure and provide hands-on local support for incident resolution

Your Profile:
• Education/Degree: Technical apprenticeship in IT with focus on Telecom or Bachelor degree within relevant fields.
• 5-6 years experience in the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of LAN/WLAN network infrastructure across campus and data center environments.
• Hands-on expertise with Cisco and Arista switching, routing, and wireless solutions.
• Strong routing and switching protocol knowledge (BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, OSPF, STP, etc.).
• Physical infrastructure management: MDFs, IDFs, cabling, PDUs, and rack power/cooling considerations.
• Experience in working with external vendors and service providers
• Soft Skills: Proactive, self-motivated, strong stakeholder management, and communication skills to collaborate with internal clients, internal cross-functional teams (Connectivity, Security, Facilities, etc.), and partners
• Languages: Fluency in German and English

Nice to Haves:
• Relevant certifications such as Cisco CCNA / CCNP / CCIE, Arista ACE, or similar
• Experience with network automation & scripting (Ansible, Python, Perl etc.)
• Experience with enterprise platforms such as Cisco DNA Center / Catalyst Center, ServiceNow, Splunk, or Arista CloudVision
• Basic understanding of network security concepts and segmentation standards (e.g., 802.1X, Cisco ISE, firewall integration).

Job profile
• Life Sciences - IT + Digital
• Basel-Stadt
• Contracting
• Full Time
• asap/latest by 01.02.26 - 12 Months (big Option for extension)
• CCIE, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, OSPF, troubleshooting, LAN/WLAN

jobs.title: Alliance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join an innovative, cross-functional environment where you will play a key role in managing strategic public-private partnerships within the healthcare and life sciences sector. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with international stakeholders, support complex research and development programs, and contribute to projects with global impact.

Hard Facts
• Start Date: ASAP
• Latest Possible Start Date: 01.03.2027
• Duration: 12 months
• Extension: Very likely
• Workload: 100%
• Location: Basel, Switzerland
• Remote Work: Up to 2 days per week
• Travel: Occasional international travel (approximately once per year, including the USA)
• Work Model: Hybrid

Your Responsibilities
• Support the execution of strategic partnership programs and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional project teams to identify partnership-relevant activities and reporting requirements.
• Maintain and oversee comprehensive project plans across multiple workstreams.
• Coordinate the creation, maintenance, and submission of key project documentation, including study plans, protocols, reports, and vendor-related documentation.
• Monitor project budgets and track costs associated with funded activities.
• Collaborate closely with finance teams to support monthly financial reporting.
• Monitor project progress and contractual deliverables and contribute to periodic reporting activities.
• Support the development of project plans, timelines, and budgets for new initiatives.
• Identify project risks and issues, support mitigation planning, and proactively escalate concerns when necessary.
• Facilitate effective communication between stakeholders and maintain sensitive partnership information and processes.

Your Profile
• Master's degree or PhD in a scientific, biomedical, healthcare-related, or comparable discipline.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience within healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, or related sectors.
• Strong understanding of drug development and/or diagnostic assay development.
• Experience in infectious disease research and development is advantageous.
• Proven experience managing projects funded by governmental grants or working within public-private partnerships, alliances, or governmental collaborations.
• Knowledge of health authority documentation and contractual compliance requirements.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive working style.
• Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively in an international and cross-functional environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

What We Offer
• Opportunity to contribute to globally relevant healthcare initiatives.
• Exposure to complex, international partnership programs.
• Collaborative and highly skilled interdisciplinary teams.
• Flexible hybrid working model.
• Dynamic environment with long-term project prospects.

Application Requirements
• CV in English.
• Degree certificate(s).
• Latest reference letter.

jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden aus der Versicherungsbranche in Bern, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Quality Master.

Für die Sicherstellung einer hohen Softwarequalität innerhalb eines Agile Release Trains (ART) suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die das Testmanagement verantwortet, die Weiterentwicklung der Qualitätsstandards vorantreibt und den Wandel hin zu einer stärker automatisierten Testlandschaft begleitet.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung innerhalb des Agile Release Trains (ART)
• Sicherstellung der definierten Teststrategie sowie eines strukturierten und effizienten Testvorgehens
• Koordination und Steuerung ART-übergreifender sowie bereichsübergreifender Tests in einer komplexen Systemlandschaft
• Schaffen von Transparenz über Qualitätsstatus, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten sowie Ableitung geeigneter Massnahmen
• Unterstützung von Product Managern und Epic Ownern bei Abnahmen und qualitätsrelevanten Entscheidungen
• Sicherstellung der Testanforderungen, Testdokumentation sowie Koordination von Testfällen und Testdaten auf Feature-Ebene
• Unterstützung beim Aufbau und der Optimierung von Konzepten zur Testdatenbereitstellung in abhängigen Systemlandschaften
• Fachliche Führung und Unterstützung der Quality Engineers sowie Moderation qualitätsrelevanter Abstimmungen
• Weiterentwicklung des Testvorgehens mit besonderem Fokus auf Testautomatisierung und End-to-End-Testing
• Analyse und Koordination von Abhängigkeiten im Zusammenhang mit Cloud-Migrationen und hybriden Systemumgebungen
• Aktive Mitarbeit in der Quality-Management-Community und Förderung des Wissensaustauschs
• Unterstützung beim Aufbau einer internen Nachfolgeperson sowie Sicherstellung des nachhaltigen Know-how-Transfers

Dein Profil:
• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbare technische Ausbildung
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) im Testmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
• Fundierte Erfahrung in agilen Softwareentwicklungsumgebungen, idealerweise mit SAFe
• Praxiserfahrung in der Einführung und Umsetzung von Testautomatisierung
• Gute Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung, insbesondere mit Java und SQL
• Zertifizierungen im Testing, beispielsweise ISTQB Advanced Level oder iSQI Certified Agile Tester
• Fundiertes Verständnis von End-to-End-Tests, Testdatenmanagement und komplexen Systemabhängigkeiten
• Begeisterung für agile Methoden und hohe Affinität zu Qualitäts- und Automatisierungsthemen
• Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie logisch-systemisches Denken
• Kommunikative, durchsetzungsstarke und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Führungskompetenz
• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per i nostri clienti del settore assicurativo di Berna, stiamo cercando un:n esperto:n, motivato:n e open-minded:n Quality Master.

Al fine di garantire un'alta qualità del software all'interno di un Agile Release Train (ART), stiamo cercando una persona esperta responsabile della gestione dei test, spinge l'ulteriore sviluppo di standard di qualità e accompagna il cambiamento verso un panorama di test più automatizzato.

I vostri compiti:
• Responsabilità per l'assicurazione della qualità all'interno del treno di rilascio Agile (ART)
• Garantire la strategia di prova definita e una procedura di test strutturata ed efficiente
• Coordinamento e controllo di test cross-ART e cross-funzionali in un complesso paesaggio di sistema
• Creare trasparenza sullo stato di qualità, sui rischi e sulle dipendenze e ricavare misure appropriate
• Sostegno ai responsabili dei prodotti e ai proprietari di epi nelle decisioni di accettazione e di qualità
• Garantire requisiti di prova, documentazione di prova e coordinamento dei casi di prova e dei dati di prova a livello di funzionalità
• Supporto per la creazione e l'ottimizzazione di concetti per la fornitura di dati di prova in paesaggi di sistema dipendenti
• Leader e supporto professionale degli ingegneri di qualità e moderazione dei voti rilevanti per la qualità
• Ulteriore sviluppo della procedura di test con particolare attenzione all'automazione dei test e alla prova finale
• Analisi e coordinamento delle dipendenze legate alle migrazioni cloud e agli ambienti di sistema ibridi
• Partecipazione attiva alla comunità di gestione della qualità e promozione dello scambio di conoscenze
• Sostegno alla creazione di un successore interno e al trasferimento sostenibile del know-how

Il tuo profilo:
• Laurea completa in informatica o formazione tecnica comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale (almeno 5 anni) nella gestione dei test o in un ruolo paragonabile
• Esperienza profonda in ambienti di sviluppo software agili, idealmente con SAFe
• Esperienza pratica nell'introduzione e nell'implementazione dell'automazione dei test
• Buona conoscenza dello sviluppo del software, soprattutto con Java e SQL
• Certificazioni in test, ad esempio livello avanzato ISTQB o tester agile certificato iSQI
• Comprensione approfondita del test end-to-end, della gestione dei dati di prova e delle dipendenze complesse del sistema
• Enthusiasm per metodi agili e alta affinità per temi di qualità e automazione
• Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali e pensiero logico-sistematico
• Personalità comunicativa, assertiva e orientata al team con competenze di leadership
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our customers from the insurance industry in Bern, we are looking for a:n experienced:n, motivated:n and open-minded:n Quality Master.

In order to ensure high software quality within an Agile Release Train (ART), we are looking for an experienced person who is responsible for test management, drives the further development of quality standards and accompanies the change towards a more automated test landscape.

Your tasks:
• Responsibility for quality assurance within the Agile Release Train (ART)
• Ensuring the defined test strategy and a structured and efficient test procedure
• Coordination and control of cross-ART and cross-functional tests in a complex system landscape
• Create transparency about quality status, risks and dependencies and derive appropriate measures
• Support of product managers and epi owners in acceptance and quality-related decisions
• Ensuring test requirements, test documentation and coordination of test cases and test data at feature level
• Support in setting up and optimizing concepts for test data provision in dependent system landscapes
• Professional leadership and support of the quality engineers as well as moderation of quality-relevant votes
• Further development of the test procedure with a particular focus on test automation and end-to-end testing
• Analysis and coordination of dependencies related to cloud migrations and hybrid system environments
• Active participation in the quality management community and promotion of knowledge exchange
• Support in establishing an internal successor and ensuring the sustainable transfer of know-how

Your profile:
• Completed degree in computer science or comparable technical training
• Several years of professional experience (at least 5 years) in test management or in a comparable role
• Deep experience in agile software development environments, ideally with SAFe
• Practical experience in the introduction and implementation of test automation
• Good knowledge of software development, especially with Java and SQL
• Certifications in testing, for example ISTQB Advanced Level or iSQI Certified Agile Tester
• In-depth understanding of end-to-end testing, test data management and complex system dependencies
• Enthusiasm for agile methods and high affinity for quality and automation topics
• Strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as logical-systemic thinking
• Communicative, assertive and team-oriented personality with leadership skills
• Very good German and English skills

jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Compliance Specialist (m/f/d) who will take ownership of the end-to-end Grant, Sponsoring & Donation (GSD) process within Roche Diagnostics Switzerland.

In this role, you will manage commercial and medical sponsorship activities from the initial request and compliance review through to contract preparation, approval, financial processing and final settlement. You will ensure compliance with Roche's internal policies, the Swiss Medtech Code and applicable regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), Healthcare Organizations (HCOs) and internal stakeholders, you will act as the central point of contact throughout the process. In addition to the operational responsibilities, you will review existing workflows, identify inefficiencies and drive process improvements, simplification and digitalization to ensure efficient and compliant operations.

Start date: asap/by arrangement

Planed Durration: 12 Months (extension possible)

Workload: 80-100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Rotkreuz

Remote: on side

Your Tasks:
• You manage commercial and medical sponsoring activities throughout their entire lifecycle—from initial approval and contract support to gathering, reviewing, and archiving all required documentation (attendee lists, event reports, photos, receipts) to ensure a complete audit trail.
• You screen incoming sponsorship requests and supporting documents (official request letters, detailed agendas, overall event budgets, up-to-date HCP CVs). Review compliance due diligence checks for HCOs and HCPs, and prepare sponsorship and engagement agreements (mostly in German, some in English) using standard templates.
• You evaluate requests against internal Roche policies and the Swiss Medtech Code. Screen for key risk factors (e.g., events held during ski season, purely tourist destinations, inappropriate entertainment or side programs, and gifts to HCPs).
• You set up new vendors/creditors (HCOs, HCPs, event agencies) and create/approve Purchase Orders (POs).
• You track and coordinate financial steps through to invoice verification and approval workflows.
• You act as the key point of contact for external sponsoring requesters and doctors' associations (coordinating event logistics/approvals), as well as internal business owners, event management, marketing, medical affairs, and local/global compliance teams.
• You maintain audit-ready, compliant records and file all process-related documents in line with information compliance standards.
• You review the existing end-to-end GSD process from start to finish to reduce operational complexity.
• You identify gaps, manual bottlenecks, and redundant handoffs.
• You develop, revive, and roll out practical solutions to digitize, simplify, and streamline workflows (including updating roles and responsibilities).

Your Profile:
• You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s degree preferred), ideally in Law, Compliance, Business Administration, or a related field, to effectively engage with highly educated stakeholders.
• You have 3–5 years of proven experience in healthcare compliance, ethics compliance, legal operations, or sponsorship management within the Pharma or MedTech industry.
• You bring solid working knowledge of the Swiss Medtech Code (mandatory—legal background alone is not sufficient) and MedTech Europe guidelines.
• You have a good understanding of relevant Swiss healthcare law (e.g., TPA/HMG, TPO/VAM) and basic familiarity with broader regulatory frameworks (such as IVDR).
• You are business fluent in both German and English (written and spoken), as most contracts are in German (with some English contracts for the French-speaking region).
• You have proficiency in MS Office; highly self-driven, flexible, detail-oriented, and pragmatic project/stakeholder manager with strong communication skills.

Nice to have:
• You bring prior experience with internal systems, processes, and compliance policies.
• You have hands-on experience opening/onboarding new suppliers and creating/managing Purchase Orders (POs).
• You have practical experience with disclosing transfers of value under Swiss Medtech and MedTech Europe rules.
• You speak French

• Hai 3–5 anni di esperienza comprovata nella compliance sanitaria, nel rispetto dell'etica, nelle operazioni legali o nella gestione della sponsorizzazione nel settore Pharma o MedTech.
• Porti solide conoscenze di lavoro del Codice Medtech svizzero (obbligatorio-solo background legale non è sufficiente) e le linee guida MedTech Europe.
• Hai una buona comprensione del diritto sanitario svizzero rilevante (ad esempio, TPA/HMG, TPO/VAM) e la familiarità di base con i più ampi quadri normativi (come IVDR).
• Lei è fluente di affari sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato), come la maggior parte dei contratti sono in tedesco (con alcuni contratti inglesi per la regione francofona).
• Hai competenza in MS Office; direttore di progetto/stakeholder altamente guidato, flessibile, orientato ai dettagli e pragmatico con forti capacità di comunicazione.

Bello da avere:

For our client, we are looking for an experienced Compliance Specialist (m/f/d) who will take ownership of the end-to-end Grant, Sponsoring & Donation (GSD) process within Roche Diagnostics Switzerland.

In this role, you will manage commercial and medical sponsorship activities from the initial request and compliance review through to contract preparation, approval, financial processing and final settlement. You will ensure compliance with Roche's internal policies, the Swiss Medtech Code and applicable regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), Healthcare Organizations (HCOs) and internal stakeholders, you will act as the central point of contact throughout the process. In addition to the operational responsibilities, you will review existing workflows, identify inefficiencies and drive process improvements, simplification and digitalization to ensure efficient and compliant operations.

Start date: asap/by arrangement

Planed Durration: 12 Months (extension possible)

Workload: 80-100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Rotkreuz

Remote: on side

Your Tasks:
• You manage commercial and medical sponsoring activities throughout their entire lifecycle—from initial approval and contract support to gathering, reviewing, and archiving all required documentation (attendee lists, event reports, photos, receipts) to ensure a complete audit trail.
• You screen incoming sponsorship requests and supporting documents (official request letters, detailed agendas, overall event budgets, up-to-date HCP CVs). Review compliance due diligence checks for HCOs and HCPs, and prepare sponsorship and engagement agreements (mostly in German, some in English) using standard templates.
• You evaluate requests against internal Roche policies and the Swiss Medtech Code. Screen for key risk factors (e.g., events held during ski season, purely tourist destinations, inappropriate entertainment or side programs, and gifts to HCPs).
• You set up new vendors/creditors (HCOs, HCPs, event agencies) and create/approve Purchase Orders (POs).
• You track and coordinate financial steps through to invoice verification and approval workflows.
• You act as the key point of contact for external sponsoring requesters and doctors' associations (coordinating event logistics/approvals), as well as internal business owners, event management, marketing, medical affairs, and local/global compliance teams.
• You maintain audit-ready, compliant records and file all process-related documents in line with information compliance standards.
• You review the existing end-to-end GSD process from start to finish to reduce operational complexity.
• You identify gaps, manual bottlenecks, and redundant handoffs.
• You develop, revive, and roll out practical solutions to digitize, simplify, and streamline workflows (including updating roles and responsibilities).

Your Profile:
• You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s degree preferred), ideally in Law, Compliance, Business Administration, or a related field, to effectively engage with highly educated stakeholders.
• You have 3–5 years of proven experience in healthcare compliance, ethics compliance, legal operations, or sponsorship management within the Pharma or MedTech industry.
• You bring solid working knowledge of the Swiss Medtech Code (mandatory—legal background alone is not sufficient) and MedTech Europe guidelines.
• You have a good understanding of relevant Swiss healthcare law (e.g., TPA/HMG, TPO/VAM) and basic familiarity with broader regulatory frameworks (such as IVDR).
• You are business fluent in both German and English (written and spoken), as most contracts are in German (with some English contracts for the French-speaking region).
• You have proficiency in MS Office; highly self-driven, flexible, detail-oriented, and pragmatic project/stakeholder manager with strong communication skills.

Nice to have:
• You bring prior experience with internal systems, processes, and compliance policies.
• You have hands-on experience opening/onboarding new suppliers and creating/managing Purchase Orders (POs).
• You have practical experience with disclosing transfers of value under Swiss Medtech and MedTech Europe rules.
• You speak French

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Pour une entreprise de l'industrie pharmaceutique, nous recherchons une personnalité expérimentée pour soutenir un projet de numérisation en cours dans le domaine des systèmes de laboratoire. L'accent est mis sur le développement et la mise en œuvre locale d'un système d'exécution de laboratoire (LES) d'utilisation mondiale basé sur le logiciel BIOVIA. L'objectif est de cartographier efficacement les processus et les flux de travail en laboratoire existants dans le système, d'optimiser les interfaces et d'identifier les synergies entre sites.

En étroite collaboration avec divers départements spécialisés internes, vous soutiendrez la poursuite de la mise en œuvre et aider à assurer la numérisation durable et la conformité dans l'environnement de laboratoire.

Faits concrets
• Date de début: 01.01.2027 (dernière date de début: 01.03.2027)
• Durée d'utilisation: 12 mois, prolongation possible
• Pensum: 100 %
• Lieu de travail: Bâle
• Bureau à domicile : présence locale prédominante requise; bureau à domicile ponctuel possible après familiarisation et consultation
• Activité de voyage : Néant
• Environnement de travail: industrie pharmaceutique, environnement réglementé GxP

Tâches et responsabilités
• Enregistrement et documentation de l'état actuel de la mise en œuvre du système d'exécution en laboratoire (LES).
• Analyse et comparaison des recettes et des flux de travail déjà mis en œuvre avec les procédures des autres ministères.
• Identification des possibilités d'optimisation, suggestions d'amélioration et synergies possibles entre les processus de laboratoire existants.
• Appui à la poursuite de la mise en œuvre et de l'adaptation locale des ERP.
• Soutien conceptuel et professionnel dans la mise en œuvre de l'interface entre LIMS et Nextlab.
• Analyse et documentation des processus opérationnels, des flux de travail et des flux de données existants.
• Coopération étroite avec les services spécialisés internes, l'informatique, l'ingénierie et l'assurance qualité.
• Veiller au respect des exigences pertinentes en matière de GxP et de conformité dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre du système.

Compétences
• Formation professionnelle ou études dans le domaine technique, pharmaceutique ou scientifique, par exemple en tant que chimique ou pharmacotechnologue, pharmacien, chimiste ou automatiste, avec une compréhension prononcée de l'informatique. À défaut, une formation en informatique ou une qualification comparable.
• Au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en laboratoire.
• Expérience approfondie de l'acquisition, de l'analyse et de la documentation des processus opérationnels et des flux de données.
• Expérience dans l'environnement GxP et non GxP, idéalement dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• Connaissance des systèmes d'information de laboratoire (LIMS) et des systèmes d'exécution de laboratoire (LES).
• Expérience idéalement pratique avec Nextlab et singleLIMS.
• Connaissance négociable de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture.

Compétences personnelles (avantages)
• Personnalité forte, représentant les positions avec confiance, abordant ouvertement des questions critiques et remettant en question de façon constructive différents points de vue.
• Méthode de travail indépendante, axée sur l'initiative et la solution, avec un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle.
• Compétences sociales fortes, flexibilité et intégrité.
• Une forte orientation client et une prise de décision cohérente fondée sur les faits.
